instruction: Fold the towel diagonally so that one corner lies on the opposite corner, then let go.

outcome.real_measurement: Same quantity and threshold as towel_fold_diagonal_v1 (cloth.corner_distance a=0, c=624), now required at EVERY step of the judged window. Real world: top-down camera, the two marked corners, metric distance via the table-plane homography, 1 s after the robot stops.
v1's cloth.footprint_ratio (convex-hull area of the top-down projection / area at reset) at every judged step. Real world: towel segmentation area from the top camera.
v1's cloth.frac_above (height 5 cm) at every judged step. Real world: side / depth camera.

counterexamples.name: drag_on_ground
counterexamples.description: drags corner A to C without lifting

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: lift, carry over C, lower, release

source.engine: newton-1.7.0 VBD cloth; robot: SAPIEN 3.0.3 / PhysX (route A) or Newton MuJoCo-Warp (route B)
source.binding_revision: 2 (2026-11-14 E20): corner-displacement quiescence; revision 1 = p95 speed <= 0.02 m/s

notes: Protocol v3 binding of the v1 towel contract for the imsim soft envs. Per-step signals are written by the env (NewtonClothWorlds.signals): towel_corner_dist and towel_frac_above_5cm on the GPU, towel_footprint_ratio by the trace recorder with veritask's scipy hull; robot_cloth_impulse = sum over the control step's VBD substeps of |contact force| * dt over all particle contacts with robot collider shapes (VBD CONTACT_F observable); finger_cloth_enclosure = sum of the two pads' clearances to the nearest particle lying between the pads (particle radius subtracted), 1 m when none lies between them; cloth_speed_p95 = 95th percentile particle speed; robot_qvel_max = largest arm joint speed from joint positions over the control step. Hold A = arm held at the joint positions reached at the policy's last step, gripper keeps its last target. Release bound 5e-4 N s per control step (= v2's CONTACT_IMPULSE_NS). Quiescence (binding revision 2, E20 development): for 10 consecutive steps the two judged corners (A, C) each move <= 3 mm and the p95 particle speed is <= 0.10 m/s (a falling towel is faster), robot joint speed <= 0.01 rad/s. Revision 1 required p95 speed <= 0.02 m/s; on E20's 64-world development runs 4/16 (route A) and 2/16 (route B) expert folds never met it because VBD keeps a folded two-layer towel jittering at 0.02-0.26 m/s p95 while its corners stay put (solver artefact, not settling); both revisions are reported in E20_REPORT.md.
